name: Farmer ID (Farmer Registry / AgriStack)
summary: A unique digital ID for each farmer that links you to your land records, so benefits under many schemes reach you faster. Do this first.

benefits.headline: One digital ID that unlocks smoother access to many schemes
details: Links your identity and your land parcels to digital land records.
Used to deliver PM-KISAN, crop insurance, agricultural credit, MSP-based procurement, and fertilizer and seed distribution more effectively.
Government statements say that registered farmers will not be deprived of any scheme benefit, while farmers who do not register may face difficulties accessing schemes.

summary: Farmers whose land is in the state's digital land records register (OTP-based Aadhaar authentication is used in many states).

steps: Look out for special registration camps run jointly by Revenue and Agriculture officials in your village or tehsil, or visit your nearest Common Service Centre (CSC).
Verify with Aadhaar OTP and confirm your land parcels.
Receive your Farmer ID and keep a copy; quote it in other scheme applications.
offline: Tehsil / revenue office and block Agriculture office
Village registration camps announced by your district administration

deadline.text: Many states are running time-bound registration drives. Do not wait: ask your Agriculture/Revenue office for the current camp dates.

caveats: Rules and deadlines are set state by state. This entry gives the general picture.
